transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining. As you know, Harbor Point Properties has submitted a restructuring request on their $8 million term loan — they're asking for a 12-month maturity extension, a waiver of the current financial covenant, and release of $900,000 of equipment collateral. Before I can record any final terms, I need each of you to walk through your findings: risk, relationship coverage, legal, and collateral management. Jonas, I'll be looking to you specifically for the covenant-testing findings and the applicable workout policy citation so I can capture the supporting sources in the minutes. Let's work through the agenda systematically so we can determine the appropriate workout treatment. Who would like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Good morning, Elena. I'd be happy to start with the covenant-testing findings. Before I walk through the specifics, I should note that I completed the covenant testing review this week but have not yet attached the testing file to the committee package — I'll make sure that gets circulated to everyone after this meeting. Now, to the findings: the current leverage ratio is 0.3x above the permitted covenant level. Under the applicable workout policy, a covenant waiver is permitted, but only with a maximum 9-month extension — not the 12 months the borrower has requested — and it requires the borrower to provide a monthly leverage certificate. I'll cite the specific policy provision for the minutes once I formally present the recommendation.
